lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×10

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Hi, Commander.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: I received the photos you sent me.
Didn't you say you'd give us some strawberry candy as a reward?

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Strawberry candy?

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: There are candies made of strawberries?

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: I wonder how that'd taste like...

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: I bet it'd be tasty!

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Anyway, who took this picture?

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: It's... not exactly what I was looking for.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: It's okay, though.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: The railroads on the surface

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: look like they stretch out into infinity.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: I'm actually thrilled with my current job,

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: but I can't help but feel somewhat sad every once in a while

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: when I gaze out at those vast vistas.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: What I'd give to blaze through those open spaces.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Here on Ark, we're like hamsters running on a wheel.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Just as we start to pick up speed, we're already at a station.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: It's a total bummer!

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: However, seeing this photo cheers me up.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Eventually, there'll be a day

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: when I can ride the rails and gaze at the horizon.
I'm sure that day will come as well.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Thank you for doing this.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: You've really helped me out.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Bye!
Say hello to Choo Choo for me.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Huh? Who are you talking about?

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: I don't get it.

lines.speaker: traingo
lines.text: Anyway, bye!
